Asalamualaykum Mufti Sahab, I have 2 sons aged 3.5 and 8 yrs. About 2-3 months ago, my wife saw a dream that she is hitting our elder son with a thick stick like object on the head. She is crying and does not want to hit him but she is continuing to hit him. Due to some reason, she is unable to stop hitting him. About a week ago I saw a similar dream about my elder son with the difference that I am hitting him all over his body with my hand. I am trying to him even harder but my strikes are not turning out to be very hard despite my attempts. He is a very beautiful and obedient child. He does tend to be very mischievous at times, but it is easily controlled by us. We are very worried about these strange dreams. Please interpret this dreams for us. Jazakallahukhaire. 1520 views Q. Allah's mecry be upon those upon his deen ameen. My question was regarding marytrdom. Why is it that according to Hanafi Fiqh, the shaheed is prayed over. My understanding of Janazah was, the Community are Mashahid over the Mayith, and hence make dua for Allah's mercy etc. As for the Shaheed, then his wounds etc are witness for him etc. And his soul (inshaAllah) would be in the hearts of green birds, roaming Jannah, and you know this narration better than i do. Jazakallahu Khair, I love you for the sake of Allah. 1533 views Q. As Salaamu Alaikum. I had a dream and would like to have it interpreted Insha Allah. I was in a house with about 5 other people both male and female, I don't think any were Muslim except for me. Something broke and 2 went to the basement to fix it, while down there, the house exploded and everyone died. In my dream we were re-created and taken back to the time before the explosion without clear memory of what was to happen. We were reading a book with stories and it became clear to me that the book was reminding me what was going to happen. I knew it was the Will of Allah SWT so I didn't fight it or try to convince other people. Instead, when I recognised the time approaching for the explosion I rushed to make wudhu & make salah as I wanted to die in a state of salah. At the time of the explosion, nothing happened. I finished my prayer and went to see the other people. One man who had gone downstairs to fix the problem(as in the beginning) smiled at me and showed me his hand which was burnt. Can you please tell me what this means? May Allah SWT reward you for your time and effort. 1610 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 5102 Country: MY Title: Someone dreamnt of saidina Ali karamallahuawajha.My question is,is it possible if shaitan laknatullah pretend to be one of the sahabah. Question: Assalamualaikum. Someone dreamnt of saidina Ali karamallahuawajha.My question is,is it possible if shaitan laknatullah pretend to be one of the sahabah. jazakallah Answer ID: 5102 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 865/771=B/1429) It is possible to see Hazrat Ali ( کرم اللہ وجہہ ) in dream; you should not baselessly think that satan pretends to be Hazrat Ali. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
